method: Manual mathematical review of all 160 saved dev outputs, grouped by exact theorem, proof body and Rocq outcome into 19 distinct combinations. Each group was inspected against the frozen A/B informal proofs and compiler diagnostics. Judgments are bound individually to every output hash. Frozen step-adherence labels are not used as mathematical-fidelity labels.
